name: Kakurezuki
source: The protagonist "Sakuya" is a being created by magic, awakening in Japan's magical research institute. His creator Shizuma Kusakabe tells him that he will spend 91 days in the mansion learning skills and interacting with different people and that he will be tested to see what growth he achieves.
translation: 主人公“朔夜”是由魔法创造的存在，在日本的一所魔法研究机构中苏醒。他的创造者日下部静马告诉他，接下来91天里，他将在宅邸中学习各种技能并与不同的人交流，最终接受测试，检验自己获得了怎样的成长。
